summary:
波音單季EPS暴增係一次性項目所致，須以調整後數字看待核心營運。
• EPS 10.23美元遠高於預期0.03美元，惟異常巨幅疑含一次性利益或稅務項目
• 營收239.5億美元，反映交機量持續回升
• 民用航太需求復甦支撐長期訂單動能
• 現金流改善方向與營運轉機趨勢一致
ai_view:
訊號需審慎解讀：31611%的EPS驚喜遠超合理範圍，幾乎可確定包含稅務、訴訟和解或資產相關的一次性項目，不應據此判斷核心獲利改善。短期股價反應應聚焦調整後EPS與自由現金流而非帳面數字。中期仍由交機量與產率主導。追蹤指標：調整後（核心）EPS、一次性項目拆解、737／787月產率、自由現金流，以及訂單淨額與庫存飛機去化。

需留意：EPS巨幅超標極可能為一次性因素，恐誤導核心獲利判讀；營收年增資料缺失，成長趨勢需其他季度佐證；本益比91.55在獲利品質存疑下評價失真

summary_en:
Boeing's single-quarter EPS spike stems from one-off items; core operations should be read on adjusted figures.
• EPS of $10.23 vastly exceeded the $0.03 estimate, but the anomalous size likely reflects one-off gains or tax items
• Revenue of $23.95B reflects continued recovery in deliveries
• Commercial aerospace demand recovery supports long-term order momentum
• Cash-flow direction aligns with the operational turnaround trend

ai_view_en:
Signal requires careful interpretation: a 31611% EPS surprise is far beyond a reasonable range and almost certainly includes tax, litigation-settlement, or asset-related one-off items, so it should not be read as core earnings improvement. Near-term, the stock reaction should focus on adjusted EPS and free cash flow rather than the headline figure. Mid-term remains driven by deliveries and production rates. Track: adjusted (core) EPS, one-off bridge, 737/787 monthly rates, free cash flow, and net orders plus destocking of inventoried aircraft.

Watch：The massive EPS beat is most likely one-off, risking a misleading read on core earnings; Missing revenue YoY means growth needs corroboration from other quarters; A 91.55x P/E is distorted given questionable earnings quality
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 10.23遠高於預期0.03，但異常巨幅驚喜31611%疑為一次性利益。
